svg.text: Simplified layout: go by the names printed on the board
Left and right motor on the two Z connectors
FYSETC NEMA 14 on the BMG 3:1 extruder (0.33 A).
Runs backwards? Turn the plug around.
PSU + and − ; check the polarity marks
Terminal order not confirmed: read the board labels.
5 V blower on FAN0. Tachometer wire unconnected.
5 V Noctua on FAN1. Tachometer wire unconnected.
The MK3S fans are 5 V fans
Next to the Probe connector (not drawn)
On 3V3 only while flashing over USB
Flat cables P1 → EXP1, P2 → EXP2.
Blank or garbled screen: a plug is the wrong way round.
Use this slot or the one of the LCD, not both
RX1 ← MMU TX through 1 kΩ, with 2 kΩ to GND.
T2 (PINDA v2 only; a SuperPINDA has none)
Signal, 5 V and GND on the Probe connector
Signal and GND on FIL-DET, 5 V from RGB.
BAT85 diode in the signal wire, band to the sensor.
Order of Probe / FIL / RGB not confirmed: read the board labels.
FAN2 · X-MIN · Y-MIN · Z-MIN · EXP3 · BLTouch · PSU power panic cable
Nothing may be plugged into X/Y/Z-MIN while the DIAG jumpers are installed.
Power panic and the fan speed check are not used in this firmware.
First start: run the Wizard, then Calibration › E-steps cal. Not yet tested on hardware.
